consent.heading: Before you share
consent.anyone: Anyone with the link can open it until it expires or you turn it off, and they can forward it.
consent.contents: It shows this report as it is now. It won't update as you log more.
consent.contentsNotes: It shows this report as it is now, including your notes. It won't update as you log more.
consent.notMedical: EatPal is not a healthcare provider, and this link is not a medical record. Send it only to people you choose.
consent.control: You can see how many times it was opened, and turn it off at any time.
